revision_summary: Eight timestamp errors surfaced by the deterministic checker, all in script_coverage / observed_outcome entries clustered around the mid-to-late call (bill amount, credit score reveal, bill collection offer, appointment setting, and button-up). All are 'wrong_ts' (words exist, timestamps off), so severity is minor, but there are enough of them (8) that they should be corrected in one pass: (1) bill_amount customer quote belongs at ~04:20/04:37 not 04:14; (2) tax_credit_qualifier '679' quote belongs at ~03:52 not 02:15; (3) bill_collection rep offer belongs at ~10:51-11:02 not 05:52; (4) bill_collection customer 'Email would be easier' belongs at ~11:02; (5) appointment_set combined quote spans 11:43 and 13:05-13:09 — split into two turns with correct ts each; (6) appointment_set customer 'ten to eleven' belongs at ~12:56; (7) button_up rep quote belongs at ~14:11-14:19 not 13:53; (8) button_up customer 'Thank you. Bye bye.' belongs at ~14:24. Also fix observed_outcome.ts to ~14:11 to match the correct location of the booking-confirmation line. Additionally: explicitly surface the co-owner-on-title (Gail Braemer) as a protocol_adherence gap in cherry_pick_moments — the rep never asked whether the mother would join the appointment, which is a direct analog to the spouse_decision protocol and deserves its own flagged moment with a coaching_implication, not just a handoff_brief footnote. Also surface the customer's mention of the Denver city financial-assistance program (01:03) as competitive/alternative-path context missing from the analysis. Finally, consolidate the three overlapping treatments of the 47%-increase/bill-flip moment (cherry_pick_moments 07:22 and 08:00, plus coaching_focus priority 1) into a single finding to avoid triple-counting one observation as three distinct coaching gaps.
